test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Amar, Bidisha, Caramel, Deepa and Ellen are sitting on a bench facing south. Ellen is sitting at one end of the bench with nobody to her left. Caramel is sitting to the immediate left of Deepa, who is sitting at the end of the bench. Amar is sitting to the right of Bidisha. In which position is Amar sitting

options.text: Exactly in between Deepa and Bidisha
Right in the middle of deepa and caramel
Right in the middle of Carmel and Bidisha
Right in between Bidisha and Ellen

solution: Given: Amar, Bidisha, Caramel, Deepa and Ellen are sitting on a bench facing south. 1) Ellen is sitting at one end of the bench with nobody to her left. 2) Caramel is sitting to the immediate left of Deepa, who is sitting at the end of the bench.
